name: HELMS-10 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant dusty starburst galaxy HELMS-10, seen by Hubble.
label: rarehelms10-hubble
story: Herschel picked out HELMS-10 as one of the earliest dusty starburst galaxies. Hubble looked here for its starlight and for a foreground galaxy that may be magnifying it as a gravitational lens.

claims.text: HELMS-10 is one of the brightest spectroscopically confirmed dusty starburst galaxies, selected from Herschel survey data
The program studies the earliest dusty starburst galaxies
Hubble imaging aimed to find a foreground lens for HELMS-10
HELMS10 is a candidate gravitationally lensed Herschel source, also listed as HERMES J005258.6+061317
